translationRepairs: The Gaoyang era knew it as Youling; Yao as Youdu; Shun carved out Youzhou.
The Gaoyang clan called it Youling; Yao called it Youdu; Shun carved out Youzhou.
Gaoyang is a named lineage or ruler, not an era; the revision also restores the parallel agents in the sentence.
An Lushan, Shi Siming, Li Huaishan, Zhu Tao, Liu Cong, and Liu Ji carved it out one after another.
An Lushan, Shi Siming, Li Huaishan, Zhu Tao, Liu Peng, and Liu Ji carved it out one after another.
The personal name is Liu Peng; Liu Cong does not correspond to the source name.
An Lushan, Shi Siming, Li Huaishan, Zhu Tao, Liu Cong, Liu Ji seized the region in succession.
An Lushan, Shi Siming, Li Huaishan, Zhu Tao, Liu Peng, Liu Ji seized the region in succession.
The literal field contains the same personal-name error.
Liu Rengong erected palaces and shrines on Daan Mountain; Wang Ruone instructed the court in alchemy; a portion of Jixian was detached to provision them.
Liu Rengong erected palaces and shrines on Daan Mountain and studied alchemy and immortal arts from the fangshi Wang Ruone; he therefore detached part of Jixian to provision them.
Liu Rengong is the subject who studied under Wang Ruone; the current translation reverses the relationship.
Liu Rengong built palaces and shrines on Daan Mountain; the master Wang Ruone taught elixir and ascension arts to the court; Jixian was split off to supply them.
Liu Rengong built palaces and shrines on Daan Mountain; he studied elixir and ascension arts under the fangshi Wang Ruone; he therefore split off Jixian to supply them.
The literal field likewise reverses master and student.
Wang Zeng's Account of Service to the Khitan records: "From Xiongzhou's Baima post, forty li by ferry to Xincheng County, the old Dukang Pavilion site.
Wang Zeng's Account of Service to the Khitan records: "From Xiongzhou's Baigou post, forty li by ferry to Xincheng County, the old Dukang Pavilion site.
The relay station is Baigou, not Baima.
Song minister Wang Zeng, Account of Presenting Matters to the Khitan, says: "From Xiongzhou Baima post one crosses the river; forty li to Xincheng County, ancient Dukang Pavilion ground.
Song minister Wang Zeng, Account of Presenting Matters to the Khitan, says: "From Xiongzhou Baigou post one crosses the river; forty li to Xincheng County, ancient Dukang Pavilion ground.
The literal field contains the same place-name substitution.
Outside the south gate is the Prince of Yu Wang's office, a place for banquets.
Outside the south gate was the Yuyue Prince's office, a place for banquets.
The current wording double-renders the title as 'Prince of Yu Wang.' Yuyue is retained as the Liao title rather than recast as the place-name Yu.
Gu'an is the standard unambiguous romanization of the county name.
Sui Kaihuang year 9 moved the seat from Yizhou Laishui to Youzhou under the old Guan County name.
Sui Kaihuang year 9 moved the seat from Yizhou Laishui to Youzhou under the old Gu'an County name.
The historical county name is Gu'an, not Guan.
Taizu raided Ding, took Xingtang, and relocated the entire populace north to Tan Prefecture on open ground; ten stockades were founded and the name Xingtang kept.
Taizu raided Ding Prefecture, took Xingtang, and relocated the entire populace north to Tan Prefecture on open ground; ten stockades were founded and the name Xingtang kept.
The source names Ding Prefecture; retaining the administrative unit improves accuracy and consistency.
Tang Dali year 4 carved it from Guan County, then abolished it.
Tang Dali year 4 carved it from Gu'an County, then abolished it.
This is another occurrence of Gu'an County.
Sui Kaihuang year 16 founded the present seat at the northwest corner of old Guan town.
Sui Kaihuang year 16 founded the present seat at the northwest corner of old Gu'an town.
The old town is Gu'an, not Guan.
Formerly the Spring and Autumn state of Wuzhongzi.
Formerly the Spring and Autumn state of the Viscount of Wuzhong.
Zi is the ruler's title; it should not be fused into a fictitious place-name Wuzhongzi.
Originally the Spring and Autumn Wuzhongzi state.
Originally the Spring and Autumn state of the Viscount of Wuzhong.
The literal field contains the same title-and-name fusion.
When Duke Huan of Qi attacked the Mountain Rong he met the mountain spirit Yu—here.
When Duke Huan of Qi attacked the Mountain Rong he met the mountain spirit Yu—this is that place.
The proposed wording correctly makes this an identification of the place rather than an English fragment.
There is Fusu Spring, very sweet; Qin crown prince Fusu, building the Long Wall northward, once encamped here;
There is Fusu Spring, very sweet; Qin crown prince Fusu, while building the Long Wall in the north, once encamped here;
The construction occurred in the north; 'northward' incorrectly suggests the direction in which the wall itself was built.
